name: Aryan Sharma
bio: Aryan's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While earning his MBA, he became fascinated by the intricate dynamics of team performance under extreme pressure, seeing parallels between Formula 1 teams and high-growth startups. After graduating, he applied his HR expertise in the tech industry before seizing an opportunity to join Blau Motorsport. He believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment, where every team member feels valued and empowered. He's particularly adept at identifying and nurturing talent, focusing on long-term growth and development.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Aryan is of average height with a confident and approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Starts every meeting with a brief inspirational quote.
Insists on having chai at precisely 3 PM every day.
